works.title: Emit event timestamps from the ingest producer
works.intended_outcome: The ingest producer adds an event timestamp to every message so the billing consumer can order events.
boundaries: The billing consumer is owned by another team and is not changed here.

facts.statement: Add an event timestamp field to every ingest message.
The producer now writes event_ts as integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
The billing consumer may expect event_ts in seconds; the conversion is not known.

details.description: event_ts: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch, never null, set when the producer receives the event.
The billing consumer reads event_ts; its expected unit is unknown.
details.uncertainty: No consumer code or contract was available in this task.
